purpose: Pre-registered assistant review sample. Evaluation only; never training.
selection_basis: 48 unique headwords; 8 cases for each volume × baseline-target/candidate-unresolved/no-candidate stratum. Within each stratum prioritize up to 1 adapted, 2 nonadapted ≤4-letter heads, 2 nonadapted ≥9-letter heads, then fill by seeded SHA256 order. Exclude prior pilot headwords and I17/I18. No future model rankings used.

split.method: Label-independent SHA256 order of connected components sharing normalized headword or page. Dynamic programming selects earliest available development allocation satisfying preregistered 3/3/4 and 3/4/3 stratum quotas. No labels or model predictions read.
split.registration_stage: Initial 48-case sample preceded all passage review. This additional split was registered after cases 1–16 had been inspected but before any future model ranking was seen, using only selection metadata.
